records.short_description: [P1] Outdated software with known vulnerabilities on Perimeter firewall / VPN (vpn.novarefino.example:443)
records.description:
Confirm the exact installed version and the vendor advisory for every CVE listed.
Apply the vendor fixed release (or the supported LTS branch) through the normal change process; emergency change if the CVE is in CISA KEV.

records.u_acceptance_criteria:
Re-run the version detection scan (nmap -sV --script vulners) and confirm the banner or package reports the fixed version.
Re-run the original exploit check (non-destructive) and confirm it fails.

records.short_description: [P2] Industrial control protocol reachable from outside the OT zone on PLC crude distillation unit (plc-cdu-01.ot.novarefino.example:502)
records.description:
Do NOT scan aggressively or patch live controllers: open a Management of Change (MOC) with Process Safety before any intervention.
Contain first: add a deny rule at the IT/OT boundary (conduit) so the protocol is only reachable from the engineering workstations and historian in the OT DMZ (zones and conduits model, IEC 62443 style).
Enable the controller's write-protection / run-mode key or protocol allowlist where the vendor supports it.
Plan the permanent fix (firmware, segmentation redesign) for the next scheduled turnaround and record it in the plant maintenance system.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
Passive check: from the corporate IT VLAN, a single TCP connect test (nc -zv <ip> <port>) must fail; no active protocol scanning on production.
OT-ENG confirms with the asset owner that HMI/historian communication is unaffected (sign-off in MOC).

records.description:

Map the rule to ATT&CK T0883, T0886, T1692 and tag alerts with F-009.
Keep the rule active until the fix ticket is verified closed.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Trigger a safe simulation of the technique and confirm the alert reaches the SOC queue.

records.short_description: [P3] SNMP v1/v2c with default or guessable community string on Core switch (core-sw01.corp.novarefino.example:161)
records.description:
Migrate the device to SNMPv3 with authPriv (SHA-2 + AES).
If v2c must stay temporarily, set a long random read-only community and an ACL that allows only the NMS address.
Disable SNMP write access entirely.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
nmap -sU -p161 --script snmp-info <host> with 'public' must fail.
NMS still polls the device over SNMPv3.

records.short_description: [P3] Users susceptible to phishing / social engineering on Workforce (users)
records.description:
Run short, role-based awareness sessions for the affected teams within 30 days (no blame, focus on reporting).
Deploy a one-click 'report phishing' button and publish the reporting channel.
Enforce MFA so a captured password alone is not enough.
Schedule a follow-up simulation in 90 days to measure improvement.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Follow-up simulation click rate below the agreed target; report rate above target.

records.short_description: [P3] Cross-site scripting (reflected or stored) on Supplier portal (suppliers.novarefino.example:443)
records.description:
Apply context-aware output encoding in the template layer for the affected parameter (HTML, attribute, JS, URL contexts).
Enable the framework's auto-escaping and remove any raw/unsafe rendering helpers in the affected view.
Deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (no unsafe-inline) as defence in depth.
Set HttpOnly on session cookies so injected script cannot read them.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
Replay the payload; it must render as inert text.
ZAP passive + active scan shows no XSS alert for the endpoint.

records.short_description: [P3] Attack activity not detected or not logged on SIEM / SOC tooling (siem)
records.description:
Onboard the missing log source (host, firewall, application) to the SIEM with parsing validated.
Create or tune the detection for the ATT&CK techniques used during the test, using the ATT&CK v20 detection strategies as a starting point.
Add the scenario to the purple-team regression list.
records.u_acceptance_criteria: Replay the test activity (atomic test) and confirm an alert is raised and triaged within the SOC SLA.

records.short_description: [P3] Missing web security headers / insecure cookie attributes on Supplier portal (suppliers.novarefino.example:443)
records.description:
Add Strict-Transport-Security (max-age >= 1 year), Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and frame-ancestors at the reverse proxy for all virtual hosts.
Set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite on session cookies in the framework configuration.
Keep the header set in a shared proxy snippet under version control.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
curl -sI https://<host> shows the headers; ZAP passive scan shows no header alerts.
Browser dev tools show the cookie flags.

records.short_description: [P4] Weak TLS configuration (old protocol versions or ciphers) on Citrix gateway (portal.novarefino.example:443)
records.description:
Disable SSLv3, TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1; keep TLS 1.2 with AEAD ciphers and TLS 1.3.
Scanner guidance: Enable TLS 1.2 or 1.3 only.
Replace self-signed or expiring certificates with certificates from the corporate or public CA and automate renewal.
Apply the change through a shared hardening baseline (Ansible/GPO) so every web front end gets it.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p443 <host> must show no TLS 1.0/1.1 and grade A ciphers only.
testssl.sh <host> shows no high or critical items.

records.short_description: [P4] Cleartext management or file-transfer protocol in use on Control room printer (prn-ctrlroom.corp.novarefino.example:21)
records.description:
Replace Telnet with SSH and FTP with SFTP/FTPS; disable the cleartext daemon after migration.
Rotate every credential that was ever used over the cleartext protocol.
Block the cleartext port at the host firewall so it cannot be re-enabled silently.
records.u_acceptance_criteria:
nmap -p 21,23 <host> must report closed/filtered.
Confirm that the replacement encrypted service accepts logins with rotated credentials.

records.short_description: Approve remediation plan: 20 P1/P2 findings, resources and risk acceptances
records.description:
Review the executive summary and the department distribution table.
Confirm owners and SLAs, or formally accept residual risk per finding (named owner + expiry date).
Schedule a weekly 15-minute remediation stand-up until all P1/P2 are verified closed.
